claims.evidence: Photos show a yellow engine block but no readable brand, model, or serial plate.
No origin documents, shipping marks, or location evidence appear in the photos.
The report lists whether the engine runs or starts as not shown.
The report lists mileage or hours of use as not shown.
The report lists whether it has been rebuilt or repaired as not shown.

risks.risk: Engine does not start or run
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting, idling, and revving
risks.if_unproven: as a non-running engine for parts only

risks.proof: Clip of a compression or oil pressure test, or borescope inspection
Photo of the hour meter or service records
Detailed walkaround video showing all parts and openings
Clear photo of the engine identification plate and serial number

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine identification plate and serial number
Video of the engine starting and running
Photo of the hour meter or service records
Import or shipping documents showing Belgium origin
response.reason: The witness identifies a diesel engine, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-running unit of unknown brand; proof of brand, running condition, and mileage would raise the value.
